card.name: Treatment wording after no specific antidote
card.fires_on: The word right after 'treatment' or 'management' (such as 'is' or 'should') in overdosage sections, following a statement that there is no specific antidote.

modes.label: Verb after treatment
modes.description: The linking verb 'is' or 'should' that follows 'treatment' just before 'supportive' or 'symptomatic'.
modes.example: Since there is no specic antidote, treatment<< is>> primarily supportive.

modes.label: Treatment or management as subject
modes.description: The noun 'treatment' or 'management' itself, placed after 'no specific antidote' and a semicolon or 'therefore'.
modes.example: There is no specific antidote for metronidazole overdose; therefore,<< management>> of the patient should consist of symptomatic

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like 'focus' and 'focused', as in treatment that focuses on supportive care.
card.plain: It lights up in overdose sections when the text says there is no antidote and treatment is only supportive.
